visits_top_primary_procedure_1.label: Top primary procedure 1
visits_top_primary_procedure_1.help: Most common procedure among those with a physician work RVU above 1, leaving out office visits, exams, therapy evaluations, psychotherapy and lab panels, across the clinician's visits in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025.
visits_top_primary_procedure_1.dev: pd_stg_visit joined to azal.procd on the visit's px before ranking; kept only when the strict physician work RVU (WORK_RVU >= 0.05, else non-facility total minus PE minus MP, else the facility equivalent; no nf_total_rvu fallback) is above 1.0 and the code is not a visit-type service: E/M 99202-99499, telemedicine E/M 98000-98016, eye exams 92002-92014, psychiatry 90785-90899, PT/OT evaluations 97161-97168, speech therapy and evaluations 92507-92508, 92521-92524, 92526, postoperative visit 99024, wellness, clinic and telehealth visit G codes (G0402, G0438, G0439, G0463, G2211, G2212, G0442-G0444, G2010, G2012, G2025), Category II (dddd F), hospital pass-through C codes and proprietary lab (dddd U) codes; see settings.PRIMARY_PROCEDURE_EXCLUDED_*. Ranked by visit count desc then code, top 5, in pd_stg_top_primary_px (Phase 2).

wrvu_total.label: Work RVU total
wrvu_total.help: Physician work RVU summed over every procedure the clinician billed in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025, priced from the Medicare fee schedule.
wrvu_total.dev: Per billed claim line: az.pat_dt work_procd_code (else procd_code), credited to the line's rendering NPI and location, counted into pd_stg_npi_px_line, then priced on azal.procd with the strict physician work RVU: WORK_RVU when >= 0.05 (0.001 placeholders fall through); else NON_FACILITY_TOTAL - NON_FAC_PE_RVU - MP_RVU when >= 0.05; else the FACILITY equivalent. 5-character CPT/HCPCS only; Category II (dddd F) codes, hospital pass-through C codes (whose lookup rows carry a facility amount in the work column) and lines with no work RVU are left out. Summed into pd_stg_npi_wrvu (Phase 4). ROUND(SUM(line_count x work RVU), 2).
caveats: Physician work RVU from the Medicare fee schedule, every billed procedure line priced.
Lines with no work RVU, Category II tracking codes and hospital pass-through C codes are left out.

Summed into pd_stg_npi_wrvu (Phase 4). wrvu_total / wrvu_procedure_count, 3 decimals.

visits_top_primary_procedure_1.label: Top primary procedure 1
visits_top_primary_procedure_1.help: Most common procedure among those with a physician work RVU above 1, leaving out office visits, exams, therapy evaluations, psychotherapy and lab panels, across the clinician's visits in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025.
visits_top_primary_procedure_1.dev: pd_stg_visit joined to azal.procd on the visit's px before ranking; kept only when the strict physician work RVU (WORK_RVU >= 0.05, else non-facility total minus PE minus MP, else the facility equivalent; no nf_total_rvu fallback) is above 1.0 and the code is not a visit-type service: E/M 99202-99499, telemedicine E/M 98000-98016, eye exams 92002-92014, psychiatry 90785-90899, PT/OT evaluations 97161-97168, speech therapy and evaluations 92507-92508, 92521-92524, 92526, postoperative visit 99024, wellness, clinic and telehealth visit G codes (G0402, G0438, G0439, G0463, G2211, G2212, G0442-G0444, G2010, G2012, G2025), Category II (dddd F), hospital pass-through C codes and proprietary lab (dddd U) codes; see settings.PRIMARY_PROCEDURE_EXCLUDED_*. Ranked by visit count desc then code, top 5, in pd_stg_top_primary_px (Phase 2).
caveats: Visit-type codes (office and telehealth visits, eye exams, psychiatry, therapy evaluations), tracking and lab-panel codes, and procedures with a work RVU of 1 or less are not ranked.
A lower bound on the group page: only members' stored top 5 codes are summed.

Group: member percent weighted by member visits_total (group_profile.weighted_pct_sql).
caveats: Visits without a valid service date are excluded.
Weighted by each member's visits.

min_providers.label: Minimum clinicians
min_providers.help: Show only groups with at least this many member clinicians in the chosen roll-up.
min_providers.dev: pd_group_practice.provider_count >= value, in the selected member_scope.

volume.label: Volume
volume.help: Visits, panel size and work RVU for the clinician in Nov 2024 to Oct 2025.
volume.dev: UI heading over visits_total, panel_size, wrvu_total, wrvu_average and wrvu_procedure_count; no table.

work_rvu_vs_specialty.label: Work RVU vs specialty
work_rvu_vs_specialty.help: How the clinician's work RVU total compares with same-specialty peers who practise in the state with at least 50 visits.
work_rvu_vs_specialty.dev: UI heading over the wrvu_state_specialty_* fields and wrvu_specialty_percentile; no table.

standing.label: Standing
standing.help: Where the clinician ranks among specialty peers on visits and on activity.
standing.dev: UI heading over visits_specialty_percentile and activity_specialty_percentile; no table.

office_em_visits.label: Office visits
office_em_visits.help: New and established patient office visits, from the office evaluation and management codes.
office_em_visits.dev: UI heading over visits_new_patient, visits_established and visits_percent_new_patient; no table.

place_of_service.label: Place of service
place_of_service.help: Share of the clinician's visits by care setting.
place_of_service.dev: UI heading over the visits_percent_office / hopd / asc / ed / telehealth / inpatient / lab / other_pos fields; no table.

visits_by_day.label: Visits by day of week
visits_by_day.help: Share of the clinician's visits on each weekday.
visits_by_day.dev: UI heading over visits_percent_monday through visits_percent_sunday; no table.

top_diagnoses.label: Top diagnoses
top_diagnoses.help: The five diagnoses most often on the clinician's visits, with each one's share of visits.
top_diagnoses.dev: UI heading over visits_top_diagnosis_1..5; no table.

top_procedures.label: Top procedures
top_procedures.help: The five procedure codes most often billed on the clinician's visits, with each one's share of visits.
top_procedures.dev: UI heading over visits_top_procedure_1..5; no table.

top_primary_procedures.label: Top primary procedures
top_primary_procedures.help: The five procedures with a physician work RVU above 1 most often billed by the clinician, leaving out office visits, exams, therapy evaluations, psychotherapy and lab panels. Empty for clinicians who bill only visit-type services.
top_primary_procedures.dev: UI heading over visits_top_primary_procedure_1..5; no table.

group_practices.label: Group practices
group_practices.help: The clinician's group practice from the master reference file, then every group the CMS reassignment file lists for them.
group_practices.dev: UI heading over group_practices[]; no table.

group_source_R.label: Master reference file
group_source_R.help: Group practice recorded for the clinician in the master reference file.

group_source_C.label: CMS reassignment
group_source_C.help: A group the clinician reassigns Medicare benefits to, from the CMS reassignment file.

referrals.label: Referrals
referrals.help: Top 5 clinicians who refer to this clinician and top 5 this clinician refers to. Clinicians in the same organization, and pathology, radiology, anesthesia and lab clinicians, are left out.
referrals.dev: UI heading over referrals[] in and out; no table.

referrals_in.label: Referrals in
referrals_in.help: Clinicians who send patients to this clinician.

referrals_out.label: Referrals out
referrals_out.help: Clinicians this clinician sends patients to.

sites.label: Sites
sites.help: The clinician's top five practice locations by visits, named from the location's DBA or registered name, else its address.
sites.dev: UI heading over practices[]; no table.

panel.label: Panel
panel.help: Age and sex of the clinician's patients, and the payers behind their visits.
panel.dev: UI heading over the panel_* and visits_percent_* payer fields; no table.

payer_mix.label: Payer mix
payer_mix.help: Share of claims by payer class: Medicare FFS, Medicare Advantage, Medicare Other, Medicaid, Commercial and HMO. Other is outside the denominator.
payer_mix.dev: UI heading over the six visits_percent_* payer-class fields; no table.

top_commercial_payers.label: Top commercial payers
top_commercial_payers.help: The five commercial payers with the most of the clinician's commercial claims, each as a share of commercial claims.
top_commercial_payers.dev: UI heading over top_payer_name_1..5; no table.

cms.label: CMS
cms.help: Group size, telehealth, secondary specialties and MIPS scores as published by CMS.
cms.dev: UI heading over group_size, telehealth_offered, secondary_specialty_* and mips_*; no table.

group_page_note.label: Summed across clinicians
group_page_note.help: Figures on a group page are summed across member clinicians and can count an encounter twice when two members billed it.
group_page_note.dev: Caption for every group page; no table.
